fallback_summary_en: Learn broad season vocabulary without pretending every climate, hemisphere, or culture divides the year into the same four pieces.

transparency_slide.description: Show the learner's strongest explanation languages first, then learning languages. Four temperate seasons are a comparison layer, not a universal climate model.
transparency_slide.rendering_model: Native-language support blurb plus structured season systems for eligible learning languages.

support_selection.full: Tier 1 or Tier 2 learning language with a knowledge-set record.
support_selection.comparison_only: Canonical learn-from language with support copy but no target eligibility.
support_selection.unavailable: No required lesson asset exists at the user's trust threshold.

title_policy.notes: The lesson title is deliberately neutral about the number of seasons.

eligibility.notes: Tier 3 languages may explain the lesson but may not be selected as learning-language targets.

block_plan.notes: Show the broad four-season comparison set first when it exists, then contextual local systems such as six ritus or wet/dry seasons.
Resolve hemisphere and climate from context; neither is a property of a language tag.

learning_path_policy.notes: Exact ordering can vary by language path; the family itself remains reusable.
